doc: Authored tail centrelines for tools/rig_meshy_tail.py (decision 0191). Points are bind-pose metres in glTF axes (+Y up, +Z front), root first. radius is the capsule that bounds the surface walk from the tail tip. Validated against rendered segmentation plots, 2026-09-26.

spring.tested: 2026-09-26 bake (decision 0192): at 0.35/0.35/3.0 the thin tail, lying on the floor at rest, folded into hairpins once the ground collided correctly. 4.0/0.9/0.5: largest one-frame step 50 deg (keeper) and 69 deg (fieldworker idle), except collect_object (112 and 94 deg, flagged in baked.json: the base straightens as she rises)

mouse_keeper.note: Chain covers the VISIBLE tail only, from the dress hem (y~0.14) to the floor. Above the hem the tail runs 1-3 cm under the dress; any capture there takes dress with it, and a spring would push it through the fabric. That part stays on the hips. 2026-09-26.

2026-09-29 bake (decision 0203): a paddle is stiff, so twice the otter's stiffness (8.0 vs 3.2), drag 0.9, half its gravity (1.0). All 10 land clips: tail no lower than 3.8 mm below the ground, feet and base; largest one-frame step 41.8 deg (carry_water_bucket_walk); constraint within 0.02 mm.

beaver_bridgewright.note: A broad flat paddle, 28 cm wide and 6-12 cm thick (mesh units), bound wholly to the Hips by Meshy. Chained because, left on the Hips, it sank up to 43 cm into the ground (collect_object), 32 cm (chair_sit_idle) and 13 cm (idle), and flew 61 cm up in the bucket walk (decision 0203). The chain starts at y 0.30, below the trouser seat, where the tail is clear of the legs; above that it stays on the Hips. Points are in the mesh's own POSITION space, which for the beaver is 1/1.1879 of its drawn size (the repair rescales by joints, not vertices); radii and clearances are converted to drawn metres. refit is off: on a flat paddle the second pass's centroids zigzag (1.09 m for a 0.47 m tail). section flat: its clearance is its thickness, and tail_flat_roll.gd keeps it level. 2026-09-29.

no_chain.mole_digger: No tail separable from the body in the 2026-09-26 bind-pose plots. The DEC-039 landmarks give moles a 120 permille stub (~0.11 m), which can ride the hips.

spring_units: Godot 4.7 SpringBoneSimulator3D: gravity in m/s^2 and radius in metres, in WORLD units -- not the skeleton's local units, although the skeleton sits under the glTF's 0.01-scale armature. Verified 2026-09-26: scaling both by 100 collapsed the squirrel forester's tail and lifted the otter's.
